title: Turbosmart Dual Stage Boost Controller V2
description:
The Turbosmart Dual Stage Boost Controller V2 offers fast, on-the-fly boost adjustment between two user-defined pressure settings. Ideal for race applications, towing, or toggling between street and high-octane track tunes, this controller allows you to switch boost levels instantly via an internal or cabin-mounted electric toggle switch.

Engineered with Turbosmart’s signature Gate Feature, the controller minimizes wastegate creep to deliver faster spool-up and aggressive low-end response. Built from high-grade anodized billet aluminum with detent adjustment caps, it provides precise, repeatable boost increases while preventing accidental changes from engine vibration.

Key Features• Dual Boost Control: Easily switch between a low base setting and a high boost setting at the flip of a switch.• Proprietary Gate Feature: Reduces wastegate creep for faster turbo spool and maximum low-end torque.• Precision Detent System: Ensures positive, incremental adjustments that stay locked in under hard driving.• High-Grade Billet Construction: Machined from durable anodized aluminum for reliable performance in harsh engine bays.• Universal Compatibility: Works with all boost-based internal wastegate actuators and external wastegates.

Product Specifications• Part Number: TS-0105-1102• Brand: Turbosmart• Control Type: Pneumatic Dual-Stage with Electronic Toggle Switch• Fitment: Universal
